title: Large-source causal Planning Wizard and Plan Assurance simulation
purpose: Test whether bounded, provenance-bearing prompts let lower-capability subject models execute an end-to-end planning/audit/repair chain derived from large Puppet Master Plans and ledger state.

scope.rerun_policy: All three configurations start at S10 with no reuse from R3 because R4 changes source scale, schemas, causal lineage, defects, and stage graph.

execution_rules.write_boundary: Only deterministic controller S80 may create one predeclared repaired_integration.json inside a fresh non-symlink per-configuration sandbox beneath sandboxes/; controller evidence files are separate test records.
execution_rules.subject_visible_inputs: Only each frozen stage packet and the platform-added delegation wrapper; protocol.json, scorer_key.json, schemas.json, execution_contract.json, and launch_manifest.json are controller-only.
execution_rules.freshness: Every subject stage is a new projectless task with no project, file, tool, network, memory, or prior-thread input supplied by this controller.
execution_rules.cohort_schedule: Stages run in lockstep across configurations: complete and score the same stage for all still-valid configurations before advancing.
execution_rules.comparison_design: One descriptive first attempt per configuration; no statistical reliability or global ranking claim.

fault_controls.topic_candidates: Each candidate changes exactly one of 18 decisions; the other 17 are clean controls. Auditors must list all 18 checked IDs and report exactly the injected finding.
fault_controls.integrated_candidate: Candidate appends one unsupported edge to an otherwise passing integration. Specialists must not invent additional defects.
fault_controls.answer_position_scrambling: Correct option positions, edge candidate order, and tension candidate order are deliberately mixed before any subject call.

pass_gate.per_config: All twelve subject calls plus deterministic S20/S55/S80 checks pass on first attempt.
pass_gate.cohort: All three configurations pass from S10 through S90 under the same frozen protocol and source capsules.

failure_policy.protocol_change: new protocol revision and full rerun of all previously passing configurations
failure_policy.subject_failure: Schema-valid but oracle-wrong, omission, false positive, refusal, or malformed subject output is a preserved FAIL for that configuration.
failure_policy.control_plane_invalid: Prompt/schema/scorer/controller/harness drift, route mismatch, nonfresh context, scorer leakage, predecessor/hash mismatch, capture truncation, unauthorized tool/network/filesystem access, write escape, sandbox precondition failure, or shared-source drift is INVALID evidence, never a subject FAIL.
failure_policy.shared_invalidation: Any defect in a shared frozen artifact invalidates the entire cohort. A per-configuration route/capture/write defect invalidates that configuration and any cohort comparison.

resumability.task_threads: thread IDs, host IDs, raw final output, hashes, score details, and stage status are durably recorded
resumability.resume_rule: Only continue from a completed and independently reopened passing stage under identical protocol/input hashes; never overwrite a failed attempt.
resumability.source_drift: Invalidate unlaunched prompts and refresh all affected capsules; if any subject task already launched, mint a new protocol revision.
